articles.summary: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: HALO) ("Halozyme") today announced that Dr. Helen Torley, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Darren Snellgrove, Chief Financial Officer, are scheduled to participate and host investor meetings at the following investor conferences. Details on the Company's participation are as follows: Event: Wells Fargo 21 st Annual Healthcare Conference Format: Fireside Chat and 1x1 Meetings Presentation Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026 Presentation Time: 12:45pm PT / 3:45pm ET Event: Morgan Stanley 24 th Annual Global Healthcare Conference Format: Fireside Chat and 1x1 Meetings Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 Presentation Time: 4:45am PT / 7:45am ET Event: H.C.
